title: Short-circuit non-finite limb joint validation before geometry math
description:
## Summary
When a limb joint position is NaN or Infinity, DefinitionValidator correctly emits NonFiniteLimbJoint but currently continues into Bounds.Contains, Vector3.Distance, and root-position math. Unity-side failures suggest malformed finite-state handling can then surface as unexpected exceptions instead of a clean validation result.

## Scope
- Treat non-finite joint position as invalid and skip all geometric comparisons for that joint.
- Preserve the explicit NonFiniteLimbJoint issue.
- Ensure later joint/root checks cannot consume the malformed value.
- Add regression coverage for NaN, +Infinity, and -Infinity component cases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- DefinitionValidator.Validate returns a ValidationResult containing NonFiniteLimbJoint rather than throwing for malformed limb positions.
- No secondary LimbJointOutOfBounds, LimbSegmentTooShort, or root geometry computation consumes a non-finite joint.
- Valid finite limb validation is unchanged.

## Validation
Unity EditMode required before Done; source-level review alone is insufficient.

## Evidence
TSK-0194 latest PlayMode failure inventory includes a non-finite limb-joint case that expected explicit validation but observed an unexpected DomainException. Current source inspection confirms the validator records NonFiniteLimbJoint but does not short-circuit subsequent Bounds.Contains/Distance checks for that same joint.

## Status
Open follow-up; source change intentionally deferred because DefinitionValidator is a large production file and the current GitHub-only editing path requires a whole-file replacement, increasing accidental-diff risk.
